data_source: real daily prices for ^GSPC via Yahoo Finance (yfinance), 2010-01-01 to 2023-12-31; target is realised volatility (close_to_close)
metrics_withheld_because: this run predates the lookahead fix in LSTM-Volatility-Prediction/data/data_loader.py. The feature scaler was fitted with fit_transform over the whole 2010-2023 series, so the test period's minimum and maximum were inside every training feature; shifting only the last 10% of the series moved the training tensor by 0.99 on a [0, 1] scale. An R2 measured that way is not evidence about held-out performance. The model has to be retrained on the fixed pipeline before any figure here is quoted; the superseded numbers are kept below as a record of what was run, not as a result.
superseded_metrics_note: produced 2026-09-09 by the leaky pipeline. Note the shape that should have prompted the question: validation R2 (0.931) exceeded training R2 (0.878) and both far exceeded test R2 (0.611).
rerun_command: python -m src.demo   # needs TensorFlow and network access to Yahoo Finance
